B0GSVTQK33.title: Beatbot Sora 10 AI Navigation Pool Vacuum, 6,800 GPH, 5H Runtime
bullets: Power Meets Practicality——Delivering 6,800 GPH suction through its HydroBalance structure, it efficiently captures leaves, sand, and debris without clogging—while maintaining a smooth and steady operation.

Extended Runtime, Less Intervention——With up to 300 minutes of continuous cleaning powered by a 7310mAh battery, the Sora covers pools up to 3,229 sq.ft (300㎡) in a single session. No need for multiple charges or mid-cycle handling.

All-Area Cleaning with Minimal Effort——Cleans floors, walls, and waterline, including shallow areas as low as 12 inches. Handles tanning ledges and sun shelves with ease, eliminating the need for manual touch-ups.

Effortless Lightweight Handling——Engineered with a balanced internal structure, the pool cleaner, offers a more agile and lightweight handling experience. Its optimized weight distribution makes lifting, carrying, and retrieving from the pool noticeably easier—reducing strain and simplifying every interaction.

Smart Waterline Parking for Easy Access——At the end of each cycle, the cleaner automatically returns to the waterline and stays in position for 10 minutes. No need to reach deep or fish it out—just grab and go.

Large Capacity, Less Maintenance——The 5L debris basket holds up to 650 leaves, reducing how often you need to empty it. Compatible with ultra-fine filtration (3 µm, optional) for enhanced cleaning when needed.
Smart Control, Simplified Use——Operate via Wi-Fi or Bluetooth with an intuitive app interface. OTA updates continuously optimize performance and features—keeping the experience seamless over time.

Saltwater-Safe & 2-Year Protection——Fully saltwater-safe (NaCl < 5000 ppm) and corrosion-resistant. Backed by 2-year protection, 30-day free returns, and 365-day availability, giving you long-term reliability and peace of mind for your premium pool investment.

B0GQ516HSY.title: Dolphin Nautilus EON 100 Cordless Robotic Pool Cleaner Ideal for Pools up to 50 FT – Wi-Fi Connected, Wall & Waterline Scrubbing, Top-Load Filter, Smart Navigation
bullets: CORDLESS ROBOTIC POOL CLEANER WITH WI-FI APP CONTROL: No cords, no tangles! Enjoy hassle-free cordless cleaning with the Nautilus EON 100. Use the MaytronicsOne app to start, stop, schedule, and customize cleaning modes when your EON is out of the water.

CLEAN FLOORS, WALLS & WATERLINE: This wall-climbing robotic pool cleaner actively scrubs and vacuums your pool floor, walls, waterline, steps, and sun ledges to help keep your in-ground pool clean and swim ready.

UP TO 2.5 HOURS OF CORDLESS RUNTIME: The rechargeable battery powers a full cleaning cycle, giving this automatic pool vacuum enough runtime to maintain most residential pools with consistent everyday cleaning.

SMART NAVIGATION FOR BETTER POOL COVERAGE: Intelligent scanning helps the robotic pool vacuum move efficiently across the pool floor and walls, reducing missed spots and improving overall cleaning coverage.

TOP-LOAD FILTER BASKET FOR EASY MAINTENANCE: The large filter basket captures leaves, dirt, and debris. Simply remove the top-load basket, rinse with a garden hose, and your pool cleaning robot is ready for the next cycle.

B0F9HHLK4J.title: Polaris Freedom SC Cordless Robotic Pool Cleaner, WiFi Enabled
bullets: Tap & Lift Removal System: For convenient retrieval at the waterline when cleaning is done — simply tap the cleaner and watch it climb up the wall to you so you can easily grab the handle as water quickly evacuates for lightweight removal.

Two Cleaning Modes: Clean the pool while you get ready. The FREEDOM SC cordless robotic cleaner cleans your floor or floor and walls in 2 hours or less — giving you enough time to do what you need before guests arrive.

Simple Charging: Recharge your cleaner in under 5 hours without ever leaving the pool deck. FREEDOM SC is rated for outdoor charging — simply attach the power cord to the back of the cleaner and plug it into any outlet nearby.

Connect With Your Cleaner: Whether you’re at home or away, you can check on your cleaner from the iAquaLink app— the industry’s highest-rated pool control app. The WiFi enabled FREEDOM SC provides charging status, allows you to select cleaning modes and sends push notifications once cleaning is complete.

Power that Endures: Optimal results require optimal power. FREEDOM SC comes with a long-lasting lithium-ion battery that won't compromise endurance or performance ensuring your pool is clean for years to come.
